description: Creates a new website project. Xodia supports React + Vite and plain HTML sites: by default it starts from the Xodia template (React + Vite: Vite + React Router + Tailwind v4); `template` "html-vite" starts a plain HTML site with Vite instead. Other frameworks (Next.js, Astro, React Router framework mode) can't be started here. Then call open_workspace.

template.description: What the site starts from: "react-router" (React + Vite, the Xodia template, default) or "html-vite" (plain HTML with Vite)
